host.description: Hostname or IP address to bind the BDII service to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

port.description: LDAP port for incoming queries (standard BDII port is 2170).

database_dir.description: Directory where BDII stores its Berkeley DB files.

tmp_dir.description: Directory for temporary files and runtime logs.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

threads.description: Number of worker threads to handle LDAP operations.

gip_enable.description: Enable or disable periodic updates from local Grid Information Providers (GIPs).

gip_update_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between GIP refresh cycles. Set to 0 to disable periodic updates.

include_files.description: List of additional config files or scripts to include at startup (space-separated in config, list in values).

log_level.description: Verbosity level: 0 (quiet) to 4 (debug). Level 3 (info) is typical for production.

suffix.description: LDAP suffix for the BDII directory (usually site-specific, often includes VO or site name).

root_dn.description: Root Distinguished Name (DN) for directory administration.

root_pw.description: Password for the root DN. Use strong password in production. Set to 'none' to allow anonymous binds (not recommended).

default: access to attrs=userPassword,shadowLastChange by dn.regex,"cn=Manager,." write by anonymous auth by self write by * none
access to * by dn.regex,"cn=Manager,." write by * read

items.description: An LDAP access control line. Format: 'access to [what] by [who] [permissions]'.

acls.description: List of ACL rules controlling access to directory entries and attributes.

backend.description: Backend database type ('bdb' or 'hdb'). 'bdb' is standard for BDII.

tls_enable.description: Enable TLS/SSL for encrypted connections to the BDII service.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to the server certificate (PEM format) for TLS.

tls_cert_key_file.description: Path to the server private key (PEM format) for TLS.

tls_ca_cert_file.description: Optional path to a CA certificate bundle for verifying client certificates (empty string = disabled client auth).

items.description: LDAP schema file name to load (e.g., 'glue.ldif', 'glue2.ldif').

schemas.description: List of schema files to load at startup. Required schemas for GRID info services are typically included by default.
